title: GUI fidelity: resolve tactical enemy-click selection and attack precedence
body:
Owner-requested GUI provenance audit by GPT-6.1 Sol at high reasoning, against released remake commit 4d70275a and research 865755e0. This is ambiguity to resolve, not a confirmed mismatch.

[ForLeftClick](https://github.com/diegoami/imperial_conquest_2/blob/4d70275aac4e155c0370a3ee23525cf34450a908/godot/Screens/TacticalBattleViewModel.cs#L745) selects friendly units only. Clicking an enemy with no own selection does nothing; with an own selection it sends Attack and leaves eligibility to the engine. Enemy detail formatting exists in the same model. The [promoted tactical report §§3 and 10](https://github.com/diegoami/imperial-conquest-2-research/blob/865755e04f107afc38cdb496669d882e2551aca6/docs/reports/2026-10-04-decompiled-tactical-battle-rules.md) says left on “a unit” selects/shows details, but also says an adjacent enemy with moves assigns a melee target. The prose does not resolve precedence or how enemy inspection is reached.

Trace TBattleMap_SelectUnit, EnemyUnitDetails (0x4378F8) and the relevant click/selection branches. Establish selection versus inspection versus target-setting separately.

Minimal matrix:
- placement and movement phases;
- no selection versus friendly selection, and any enemy-inspection state that actually exists;
- adjacent versus distant enemy; selected friendly with positive versus zero moves;
- left click, right click and Cancel selection controls.

For each record selected slot/cursor, details fields shown, target assignment, moves/shots and any state change or refusal. Check exactly which enemy fields are visible through click, roster, planned attack and actual exchange, without assuming all those routes share a policy. Current code was checked for withholding in ParticipantLines; no information leak was demonstrated by this audit.

Do not broaden into AI targeting or combat arithmetic already covered by tactical research25/build1355. Owner-approved colors, compact lists, animation and layout are presentation choices and need not be replicated pixel-for-pixel.

Acceptance: a bounded report with code-site and runtime evidence, exact EXE identity, a reproducible control matrix, observation/inference separation and explicit untested cases. Preserve inputs and keep original bytes, screenshots and private per-save hashes outside public GitHub. No remake implementation is requested. Do not interrupt the owner's running game; coordinate native Windows runs when needed.
